retrievalProfile.description: A gritty urban portrait featuring a central figure against a gold-painted brick wall with stenciled typography and high-contrast streetwear elements.
triggerTerms: streetwear jacket with bold graphic embroidery

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, medium-close-up portrait of a male figure in urban attire, positioned against a textured gold-painted brick wall. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to emphasize a fist extended toward the camera, adorned with a large white star ring, while the background features large-scale, stenciled, distressed typography and colorful graffiti tags.
coreVisualRelationships: The extended fist creates a foreground anchor that leads the eye to the subject's face.
The gold brick wall provides a high-texture, high-contrast backdrop for the dark streetwear.
The red accents on the jacket collar and zipper mirror the red spray-paint elements on the wall.
The large stenciled letters at the top frame the subject's head and cap.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, medium-close-up, with a prominent foreground element (fist) creating a sense of depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white star ring on the extended fist in the lower-left foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright star ring, moves up the arm to the subject's face, then outward to the large background typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with texture, color, and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Metallic gold and black (background and clothing).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright red (jacket trim and graffiti accents).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and blues against a high-value metallic gold and low-value black.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between metallic and matte surfaces

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif or stencil display face
letterConstructionRules: Distressed, weathered texture suggesting spray paint or stencil application
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are filled with a metallic gold texture that differs from the wall
Outer edges show 'overspray' or bleeding effects

treatment.shadow: Subtle drop shadow on the wall

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Combine heavy display stencils with illustrative, graffiti-style script for secondary elements.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, industrial stencil look.
Provides the necessary slab-serif weight and structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a black and red streetwear jacket and cap, standing against a gold-painted brick wall with red and blue graffiti. His fist is extended toward the camera wearing a white star ring.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, distressed, gold-textured slab-serif stencil lettering across the top of the image, positioned behind the subject's head.

verificationChecks: Is the gold texture on the wall and text distinct?
Does the star ring in the foreground have high visual prominence?
Is the typography weathered and integrated into the wall surface?
Is the red accent color consistent across the jacket and wall?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the gold metallic sheen
Subject's pose and proximity to camera
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the clothing
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text appears to be part of the wall environment.
Check that the fisheye-like perspective on the hand is maintained.
Verify the high-contrast lighting on the subject's face.
Confirm the star motif is repeated in both jewelry and clothing graphics.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait = (Textured Metallic Background + Distressed Stencil Type) * (High-Contrast Streetwear Subject + Foreground Depth Anchor)
